advisories.reason: Memory exhaustion in zod 4's $ZodArray when an unbounded array schema validates a very large array. The vulnerable code ships inside zod 3.25.76 only under the zod/v4 subpath, which nothing here loads: @x402/core and @x402/evm (latest 2.28.0 still requires zod ^3.24.2) import the zod 3 root, viem's abitype uses zod only in its unused abitype/zod entry, and ARL code does not import zod. scripts/check-zod-v3-only.mjs fails CI if either changes. Remove when @x402 supports zod >= 4.6.6.
